title: Derived identity normalization under equality transport
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a derived category, F and G exact additive endofunctors, and h:F=G and hd:DF=DG equalities. Let a:G≅Id and k:F≅Id satisfy eqToIso(h) followed by a equals k. If kd:DF≅Id has, on every complex P, hom component F-factors(P) followed by Q of the termwise k component, then Da followed by the derived identity isomorphism equals eqToIso(hd) inverse followed by kd.

source.place: Step 6: canonical identity/composition normalization; localization universal property.

source.place: Derived natural isomorphism factor, identity and composition normalization lemmas; Localization.natTrans_ext.

proof.text: Equality induction and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_refl identify the derived image of eqToIso(h) with eqToIso(hd). Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_trans to the ordinary identity equality, cancel the derived equality isomorphism, and substitute the normalized formula for kd.

theorem podReindexingDerivedIdentityNormalization {C : Type*}
    [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    (F G : C ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (h : F = G) (hd : F.mapDerivedCategory = G.mapDerivedCategory)
    (a : G ≅ 𝟭 C) (k : F ≅ 𝟭 C) (kd : F.mapDerivedCategory ≅ 𝟭 _)
    (hraw : eqToIso h ≪≫ a = k)
    (hmodel : ∀ P : CochainComplex C ℤ, kd.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) =
      F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex k.hom (.up ℤ)).app P)) :
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso a ≪≫ Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C =
      (eqToIso hd).symm ≪≫ kd
